name: Spirit
hint1: Smudge sticks prevent this ghost from hunting for 180 seconds instead of the usual 90.
hint2: It has no distinct strengths during a hunt; it moves at standard speed and accelerates normally.
riddle: Burn your incense and I will wait… longer than the rest.

name: Wraith
hint1: This ghost will never step in a salt pile.
hint2: Can teleport directly to a random player outside of a hunt, generating an EMF 2 reading at that player's location.
riddle: Salt cannot stop what never walks. The ground does not remember my steps.

name: Phantom
hint1: Taking a photo of this ghost will cause it to temporarily disappear.
hint2: It is invisible for longer periods during a hunt compared to a normal ghost (blinks slower).
riddle: Look at me too long and you will fade. Capture my face and I disappear.

name: Poltergeist
hint1: Known for throwing multiple items at once (the 'bomb' effect).
hint2: Will throw an item exactly every 0.5 seconds during a hunt if items are nearby.
riddle: Give me a room full of objects, and I will make it a storm.

name: Banshee
hint1: Targets only one specific player at a time until they die or leave the house.
hint2: Has a distinctive paranormal scream that can only be heard through the parabolic microphone.
riddle: I hear many voices, but only one matters. When the hunt begins, my favorite should run.

name: Jinn
hint1: Cannot turn off the breaker. Speeds up when the breaker is on and it sees a player.
hint2: Can instantly zap 25% sanity from a nearby player if the breaker is on, leaving an EMF 2 at the breaker.
riddle: Give the house power and I gain mine. Cut the lights, and I lose my edge.

name: Mare
hint1: Cannot turn lights ON. More likely to hunt in the dark.
hint2: Has a higher chance to perform light-shattering ghost events and will instantly turn off a light switch if you turn it on.
riddle: Darkness is my comfort, light is my enemy. Break the bulb and I feel at home.

name: Revenant
hint1: Moves incredibly slowly when it doesn't see a player, but sprints very fast when it does.
hint2: Instantly accelerates to 3.0 m/s as soon as it gains line of sight, making it one of the fastest hunters.
riddle: When I know where you are, I fly. When I do not, I wander slowly.

name: Shade
hint1: Will not initiate a hunt if multiple people are in the same room.
hint2: Extremely inactive compared to other ghosts; very rarely performs interactions or events while players are near.
riddle: Crowds make me quiet. Alone, I become bold.

name: Demon
hint1: Has a rare ability to hunt at ANY sanity level.
hint2: Smudge sticks only prevent it from hunting for 60 seconds, rather than the standard 90 seconds.
riddle: Your sanity means little to me. I grow restless long before others dare.

name: Yurei
hint1: Has a unique ability to rapidly drain sanity by fully closing doors.
hint2: Lighting a smudge stick in its room will temporarily trap it there, preventing it from wandering for 90 seconds.
riddle: I cling to one place and drain what keeps you sane. Doors close when I am near.

name: Oni
hint1: Cannot perform the 'airball' (smoke cloud) ghost event. Highly active when players are nearby.
hint2: It is visible for longer periods during a hunt compared to a normal ghost (blinks much faster).
riddle: I am loud, I am active, and I do not hide my anger when you stand near.

name: Yokai
hint1: Talking near this ghost can trigger hunts at high sanity. It is almost deaf during hunts.
hint2: During a hunt, it can only hear voices or sense active electronic equipment from about 2.5 meters away.
riddle: Speak too much and I will hear you. Silence is your safest friend.

name: Hantu
hint1: Moves much faster in cold rooms and slower in warm rooms.
hint2: Will never turn on the breaker. It produces visible freezing breath during a hunt if the breaker is off.
riddle: Cold air feeds my speed, warm lights slow my heart.

name: Goryo
hint1: Its D.O.T.S. evidence can usually only be seen through a video camera.
hint2: Will rarely wander far from its favorite room and cannot change its favorite room on its own.
riddle: Through the lens I reveal myself, but in your own eyes I prefer to stay unseen.

name: Myling
hint1: Its footsteps are completely silent during a hunt until it is very close.
hint2: Produces paranormal sounds on the parabolic microphone much more frequently than other ghosts.
riddle: You may hear the house, but not my steps. Silence is my warning.

name: Onryo
hint1: A lit candle acts like a crucifix. It will attempt to hunt if a flame is blown out.
hint2: Blowing out exactly 3 candles will force it to attempt a hunt, completely regardless of your current sanity.
riddle: A single flame can hold me back, but when it dies, I may strike.

name: The Twins
hint1: Can interact with objects in two different rooms at the exact same time.
hint2: One twin hunts slightly faster than a normal ghost, while the other twin hunts slightly slower.
riddle: One of me here, one of me there. You will never know which is real.

name: Raiju
hint1: Speeds up significantly when moving near active electronic equipment.
hint2: Disrupts electronic equipment (flashlights flickering) from much further away (15 meters) than a normal ghost.
riddle: Your devices betray you. The more they buzz, the faster I move.

name: Obake
hint1: Has a small chance to leave a unique 6-fingered fingerprint.
hint2: Has a 6.6% chance every time it flickers during a hunt to momentarily shapeshift into a different ghost model.
riddle: Not every handprint stays the same. Look closely — I cannot keep one shape.

name: The Mimic
hint1: Always presents Ghost Orbs as a fake fourth evidence. Copies other ghost behaviors.
hint2: Will secretly change which ghost it is currently copying every few minutes.
riddle: Do not trust what you see. I may be anyone but myself.

name: Moroi
hint1: Its speed increases as the average team sanity drops. Curses players via the Spirit Box.
hint2: During a hunt, using a smudge stick will blind this ghost for a full 12 seconds instead of the standard 6 seconds.
riddle: Your voice may curse you, and weakness makes me swift. The lower you fall, the faster I come.

name: Deogen
hint1: You cannot hide from it. It moves very fast from afar but to a crawl when near you.
hint2: Has a unique heavy breathing audio response on the Spirit Box if you are standing directly on top of it.
riddle: You cannot hide from what always knows. Run far and I rush, stand close and I crawl.

name: Thaye
hint1: Starts the match very active and fast, but 'ages' and slows down significantly over time.
hint2: Unlike most ghosts, it does not slowly speed up upon maintaining a line of sight with a player during a hunt.
riddle: Time is my enemy. I begin strong, but age steals my speed.

name: Dayan
hint1: Always female. Speeds up dramatically when players move near her (within 10m), but slows if they stand still.
hint2: Does not leave ultraviolet footprints in salt, but will still visibly step in and disturb the salt pile.
riddle: My presence flickers between moments. A blink, a whisper, then nothing.

name: Gallu
hint1: Cycles through Normal, Enraged, and Weakened states. Using protective equipment triggers its enraged state.
hint2: Dropping a crucifix inside its favorite room will temporarily force it to revert back to its Weakened state.
riddle: My temper shifts without warning. Calm one moment, relentless the next.

name: Obambo
hint1: Alternates between a Calm state (hunts at 10% sanity) and an Aggressive state (hunts at 65% sanity) every two minutes.
hint2: Its favorite room will immediately change to a random adjacent room the moment it enters its Aggressive state.
riddle: I move where I please, sometimes where I should not be. You may chase the wrong shadow.
